title: 870. Nth Magical Number

examples.explanation: The magical numbers start 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, ..., so the first one is 2.
Listing them in order gives 2, 3, 4, 6, so the fourth is 6.
Every even number is magical here, so the fifth one is 10.
